Safety warnings
Lithium acetate: May cause eye and skin irritation. May cause respiratory and digestive tract irritation.
The toxicological properties of this material have not been fully investigated.
Boric acid: May damage fertility. May damage the unborn child.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including a lab coat, nitrile gloves and safety
glasses.

Make the LAB buffer

For a class of 24, I usually prepare 6x 
1 L  bottles of 1X LAB. We go through a lot --

NAME
LAB Agarose Gel Electrophoresis Buffer Recipe
CREATED BY
Brian Teague
Preview
Protocol
Instructor Tips & Common Student Errors
2
Instructor Tips
The benefit of using LAB is the ability to run gels at higher voltage -- our "mini" gel
tanks go at 120 V for 20 minutes and get pretty decent gels. It is totally possible to
cast, load and run an LAB gel in 2 hours.
I usually demonstrate the proper assembly of the gel tank
Gels with Sybr Safe are fine in the refrigerator for 48 hours, but much longer than that
and the stain degrades too much. That is -- a gel cast on Tuesday will be fine for a lab
on Thursday, but not the other way around. To store a gel, put it in a zipper sandwich
baggie and add a splash (not more) of LAB buffer. Label and store at 
4 °C in the
refrigerator.
A common student error is to forget the DNA stain. But all is not lost -- you can post-
stain these gels. Put the gel in a small container (a tip box lid is often fine), cover with
LAB, add 
5 µL  of Sybr Safe, and put on a slow rocker or orbital shaker.
3
Common Student Errors
Forgot to add the DNA stain
Didn't 100% dissolve the agarose (it should be CLEAR AS WATER, no flecks floating
around in it)
Ran the gel backward (remember, "run to red")
Only ran 
1 µL  of the restriction digest (instead of the whole digest)
3/4

Alternately, ran the entire PCR (instead of just 
1 µL ) -- leaving not enough to
purify.
4/4

translation_zh.title: 琼脂糖凝胶电泳（教师用方案）
translation_zh.abstract_zh: 这是配套的教师用方案。操作本身相当直接，但我列出了几个需要留意的学生常见错误。

steps.text_zh:
按配方配制 LAB 缓冲液（配方见原方案中链接的独立协议 “LAB Agarose Gel Electrophoresis Buffer Recipe”）。

对于 24 人的班级，我通常配制 6 瓶 1 L 的 1X LAB 缓冲液。用量很大——整个学期要跑三次胶，还不算重做的。
steps.source_text: Make LAB buffer following this recipe: For a class of 24, I usually prepare 6x 1 L bottles of 1X LAB. We go through a lot -- there are three gels that get run over the course of the semester, plus repeats.

steps.text_zh:
使用 LAB 缓冲液的好处是可以在更高电压下跑胶——我们的“mini”电泳槽在 120 V 下跑 20 minutes 就能得到相当不错的胶。在 2 hours 内完成灌胶、上样和电泳是完全可行的。

我通常会示范电泳槽的正确组装方法。

加了 Sybr Safe 的胶在冰箱里放 48 hours 没问题，但再久染料就降解得太厉害了。也就是说：周二灌的胶周四上课能用，反过来不行。保存时把胶装进自封袋，加一点点（不要多）LAB 缓冲液，贴好标签后于 4 °C 冰箱保存。

一个常见的学生错误是忘记加 DNA 染料。但还有救——这些胶可以后染。把胶放进小容器（枪头盒盖通常就行），用 LAB 缓冲液没过，加入 5 µL Sybr Safe，然后放在慢速摇床或轨道摇床上。
steps.source_text: Instructor Tips: The benefit of using LAB is the ability to run gels at higher voltage -- our "mini" gel tanks go at 120 V for 20 minutes and get pretty decent gels. It is totally possible to cast, load and run an LAB gel in 2 hours. I usually demonstrate the proper assembly of the gel tank. Gels with Sybr Safe are fine in the refrigerator for 48 hours, but much longer than that and the stain degrades too much... To store a gel, put it in a zipper sandwich baggie and add a splash (not more) of LAB buffer. Label and store at 4 °C in the refrigerator. A common student error is to forget the DNA stain. But all is not lost -- you can post-stain these gels. Put the gel in a small container (a tip box lid is often fine), cover with LAB, add 5 µL of Sybr Safe, and put on a slow rocker or orbital shaker.

steps.text_zh:
· 忘记加 DNA 染料
· 琼脂糖没有 100% 溶解（应该像水一样清澈，不能有悬浮的絮状物）
· 电泳方向接反了（记住口诀 “run to red”，即 DNA 向红色正极迁移）
· 只上样了 1 µL 酶切产物（而不是整个酶切体系）
· 反过来，把整个 PCR 产物全部上样（而不是只取 1 µL），导致剩余量不够做纯化
steps.source_text: Common Student Errors: Forgot to add the DNA stain; Didn't 100% dissolve the agarose (it should be CLEAR AS WATER, no flecks floating around in it); Ran the gel backward (remember, "run to red"); Only ran 1 µL of the restriction digest (instead of the whole digest); Alternately, ran the entire PCR (instead of just 1 µL) -- leaving not enough to purify.

safety_warnings_zh: 乙酸锂（Lithium acetate）：可能引起眼睛和皮肤刺激。可能引起呼吸道和消化道刺激。该物质的毒理学性质尚未得到充分研究。
硼酸（Boric acid）：可能损害生育力。可能对胎儿造成伤害。
请佩戴适当的个人防护装备（PPE），包括实验服、丁腈手套和护目镜。

Sybr Safe —— DNA 染料商品名，保留原名不译
